title: Divergence: RATIONALE preamble drops the SOTA survey's novelty hedge for the caged quantifier fragment ('needs a targeted survey to confirm novelty')

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: RATIONALE preamble quotes the SOTA survey as recording all three novel pieces as 'GENUINE EXTENSION — no analogue in the surveyed verified-compilation literature'. That quote matches the anti-Goodhart battery row exactly, but the caged-quantifier-fragment row (.design/research/formal-methods-sota.md terminology map) reads 'no DIRECT analogue in the surveyed verified-compilation lit; NEEDS A TARGETED SURVEY TO CONFIRM NOVELTY'. The preamble flattens that hedge across all three claims (the combinator-cage entry's 'novel-by-absence' is closer but still drops the explicit caveat). A hostile reader who opens the cited survey sees the dropped qualifier — the marketing-overclaim charge, self-inflicted.
